subject: Figurative constant values
notes: kb/Work PB71 (2026-08-18): literal-1 is an alphanumeric (plain or hexadecimal), boolean or national literal, or a concatenation of them - ONE grammar arm (ALL allLiteral), ONE constructor (BoundAllLiteral.Of - the category rides on literal-1's class through CobolLiteral.ClassOf), the & fold per 8.8.3.3 GR2; a zero-length literal-1 is COBOL1648 and a mixed-class concatenation COBOL1540 (the version pass); the national/boolean literal-1 is the COBOL-2002 introduction below 2002 (COBOL0900). Before: ALL N"..." had no grammar arm, ALL B"..." parsed and died at run time, VALUE refused NX"..."/BX"..." and every ALL literal (a raw-text classifier).
